csv_project_name: AE for Old County Building Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The Jackson Fiscal Court invites Architect/Engineer (A/E) firms to submit their qualifications for design services to assist the Jackson County Fiscal Court in the design work to renovation the old county building for use as a small business incubator and Tourism Center and construct of an outdoor event space in the front of this building on the courthouse square and other similar work.The proposed sites are located on the courthouse square in McKee, KY. The Architect/Engineer (A/E) selected will work with the Fiscal Court, Tourism Board and authorized representatives to ensure all criteria for achieving desired plan for the site is completed within the budget and time frame.
